title: Scope note edits to a verified Chance file
goal: Harden update_jobnimbus_note so a raw activity id cannot bypass the normal Chance-file match and edit an unrelated company note. Require a file query, resolve the Chance-owned file, and verify the target activity belongs to that file before planning or executing PUT /activities/{id}.
doneCriteria: The action requires both a Chance-file query and noteId.
The target activity is verified as related to the resolved file before execution.
Dry-run remains the default and ALLOW_JOBNIMBUS_WRITES plus execute:true remain mandatory.
A wrong-file or unrelated note id fails without issuing a PUT.
Fixture-safe checks cover the allowed and rejected paths.
constraints: Do not weaken write gates or Chance-only scope.
Do not test with a live write.
Do not include client PII, note bodies, credentials, or runtime exports in Git.
Use the artifact mailbox only if normal Git push fails.

log.note: created during review of e28024c; update_jobnimbus_note skips requireFileMatch and plans a PUT from noteId alone

Hardened. The dispatcher no longer special-cases update_jobnimbus_note: ALL actions now resolve a Chance file via requireFileMatch, so a bare noteId can no longer plan a PUT. planUpdateNote requires {query, noteId}, fetches the activity read-only, and refuses the edit unless the activity is related to the resolved file (activityFileIds + noteOwnershipError). Dry-run default and ALLOW_JOBNIMBUS_WRITES+execute gates unchanged; fixture mode refuses (ownership needs a live read). Fixture-safe checks in selftest.js cover primary-match/related-match allowed and wrong-file/missing-activity rejected. npm run check exit 0.
Reviewed commit 2e2717e. Ownership helpers and dispatcher behavior satisfy the task; fixture-safe allowed/rejected checks pass. No live write was performed. Task closed.

result.summary: update_jobnimbus_note now requires a Chance-file query + noteId and verifies the activity belongs to the resolved file before any PUT.
result.verification: npm run check exit 0; note-ownership guard unit-checked (allowed via primary/related, rejected on wrong-file/missing activity).
